backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing user profiles, products, and orders with role-based access control (admin/vendor/customer), integrating authorization and blob storage mixins, and providing CRUD operations with permission checks.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that converts old Text-based user roles to new enum-based UserRole variants (#vendor, #admin, #customer) while preserving existing products and orders data structures.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three high-confidence features related to debugging and fixing admin dashboard access denial errors, authorization check logic, and error logging in AdminRegistration and ProtectedAdminRoute components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including routing, authentication, dashboards, forms, and UI components with details on role-based access, product management, order handling, and vendor operations.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar components using oklch color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the GreenPlantz application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, vendor dashboard, admin dashboard, and admin registration, wrapped in QueryClientProvider with error boundaries and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminRegistratio: Admin registration component handling Internet Identity authentication, profile creation with UserRole.admin enum, comprehensive debug logging for authorization flow, and error handling for profile submission and admin verification.
frontend/src/components/CommissionEditor: Dialog component for editing vendor commission settings, supporting both percentage and fixed amount commission types with validation and mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary component that catches and categorizes errors (authentication, network, router, backend) with user-friendly messages and detailed dev-mode logging.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with header navigation, authentication controls, and conditional rendering of admin/vendor dashboard links based on user role.
frontend/src/components/LoadingSpinner.t: Simple reusable loading spinner component with optional text label using Lucide icons.
frontend/src/components/OrderCreationFor: Form component for creating new orders with customer details, shipping address, and payment information, using mutation hooks and toast notifications.
Displays a list of orders with expandable details, status badges, and integrates vendor assignment, shipping details, and status editors for each order.
frontend/src/components/OrderStatusEdito: Select dropdown component for changing order delivery status with placeholder implementation noting backend method is not yet available.
frontend/src/components/PaymentManagemen: Displays orders organized by payment status (Pending, Partially Paid, Fully Paid, Adjustment Settlement) in a tabbed interface. Renders order cards showing customer details, amounts, courier info, and payment status badges.
frontend/src/components/PaymentStatusEdi: Provides a dropdown select component to update an order's payment status with loading state and toast notifications. Uses the useUpdatePaymentStatus mutation hook to persist changes.
frontend/src/components/PhotoUploader.ts: Handles image file uploads with automatic watermark detection and application ("greenplantz.com" text at three positions). Converts images to ExternalBlob format with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/ProductEditDialo: Dialog for editing product details including quantity, enabled status, and photos. Shows alerts for unsupported changes (name, description, price) and handles photo uploads with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/ProductList.tsx: Displays vendor products in a grid layout with inline quantity editing capability. Shows disabled products with visual indicators and alerts when products are disabled by admin.
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin view for managing all products across vendors with search functionality and enable/disable toggles. Displays summary statistics for total, enabled, and disabled products.
frontend/src/components/ProductUploadFor: Form component for vendors to upload products with name, description, price, quantity, and photos (minimum 2 required). Handles product creation via mutation hook and displays success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedAdminRo: Route guard component that checks authentication and admin privileges before rendering AdminDashboard. Shows loading states, error messages, or access denied screens based on user status.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedVendorR: Route guard component that verifies authentication and vendor profile existence before rendering VendorDashboard. Displays appropriate error screens for unauthenticated or non-vendor users.
frontend/src/components/ShippingDetailsF: Form component for updating order shipping information with tracking details. Uses mutation hook to submit tracking info and displays loading/success states.
frontend/src/components/TeamMemberDialog: Dialog component for creating or editing team members with form validation for Principal ID, name, email, and position. Handles both create and update operations with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/TeamMemberManage: Admin interface for managing team members with search, filtering, status toggling, editing, and deletion. Displays summary statistics and uses table layout with action buttons.
frontend/src/components/VendorAssignment: Component for assigning active vendors to orders via dropdown selection. Filters active vendors and handles assignment through mutation hook with success/error alerts.
frontend/src/components/VendorManagement: Admin component for managing vendors with table view, search, toggle active status, commission editing, deletion, and vendor product viewing. Includes statistics for product and order counts per vendor.
frontend/src/components/VendorProductsVi: Displays a grid of products for a specific vendor with product images, SKU, enabled status, pricing, and stock information. Includes edit functionality via ProductEditDialog.
frontend/src/components/VendorRegistrati: Registration form for new vendors requiring Internet Identity authentication. Collects business details (name, contact, address, pincode) and creates both user and vendor profiles.
frontend/src/components/VendorSuggestion: Component that finds and suggests nearby vendors for an order based on pincode and product name. Displays matching vendors with availability status.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication. Invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient configuration with delegation handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, vendor data, products, orders, team members, and admin operations using TanStack Query and the ICP actor interface.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a nature-inspired color palette (forest greens, sage, moss) for both light and dark modes, plus base typography styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root React component wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider for state management and authentication.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying order statistics, vendor counts, and tabbed interface for managing orders, payments, vendors, products, and team members with a hero banner.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section promoting GreenPlantz as India's plant marketplace, featuring vendor registration CTA and three feature cards highlighting product management, order assignment, and business growth.
frontend/src/pages/VendorDashboard.tsx: Vendor dashboard displaying order statistics (total, pending, completed), product upload form, product list management, and assigned orders list with hero banner.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the application including UserProfile, Vendor, Product, Order, Address, DeliveryStatus, PaymentStatus, TeamMember, and ExtendedActorInterface matching backend canister types.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to clear parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, typography, container queries, animations (accordion), custom fonts (Inter, Poppins), and extended theme utilities.
project_state.json: Project state document for GreenPlantz marketplace (version 39) describing a two-sided vendor-admin platform with product management, order assignment, commission handling, and known issues including blank home page and broken admin authentication redirecting to vendor dashboard.
